data.title: Gradiant Wins New Water Contracts for Major US Semiconductor Fabs in New York, Virginia, Idaho, and Utah
data.description: In Boston, Gradiant, a key player in the AI economy's water sector, revealed securing $300 million in fresh contracts from semiconductor manufacturing clients in 2026, showcasing robust commercial growth in an industry where water stability is increasingly vital for operational efficiency. The company achieved significant contract victories with various top semiconductor manufacturers globally, encompassing five production locations in New York, Virginia, Idaho, and Utah. The agreements involve various projects aimed at enhancing water efficiency and security.

data.title: Perk Brings Its Award-Winning Spend Platform to the US, Already One of the Company's Fastest-Growing Markets
data.description: The AI-native platform for travel and spend management, Perk, has launched its fintech product Perk Spend in the United States. The country currently sees customers spending over $1 billion annually on work travel and team events. This expansion signifies Perk’s goal to serve as the go-to solution for diverse global teams' evolving travel and spending requirements. The introduction of Perk Spend in the US comes after its successful debut in Europe, where it has already secured up to 40% of new deals.

data.title: Array and Tyfone Announce Partnership to Bring Financial Security Tools to More Community Banks and Credit Unions
data.description: The collaboration between Array and Tyfone has resulted in the incorporation of Array's entire product lineup into Tyfone's digital banking service. This includes the introduction of an AI chat feature, effortless activation process, and highly personalized banking experience. The partnership aims to provide enhanced services to customers, with these advancements being rolled out in New York on September 15, 2026. Array, a fintech platform known for its comprehensive financial tools, is now seamlessly integrated into Tyfone's digital banking interface, offering a cutting-edge banking experience.

data.title: HAGENS BERMAN, NATIONAL TRIAL ATTORNEYS, Encourages FuelCell Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCEL) Investors with Substantial Losses to Contact Firm
data.description: In San Francisco on September 15, 2026, a national trial law firm known as Hagens Berman has issued a warning to investors holding stakes in FuelCell Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCEL) about a securities class action being initiated. The firm advises investors that they only have until November 10, 2026, to apply for consideration as the lead plaintiff in this case.

data.title: 5Star Life Insurance Company Selects Benekiva to Modernize Worksite Health Claims
data.description: Aiming to enhance operational efficiency and improve the claims process for policyholders, 5 Star Life Insurance Company (5Star Life) based in Lincoln, Nebraska, announced on September 15, 2026, its partnership with Benekiva. This collaboration will involve the adoption of cutting-edge claims management technology.

data.title: Applied Photonix Launches ViroZap®, the First FDA-Cleared Medical Device for In-Duct Air Disinfection
data.description: Cutting-edge technology for disinfecting the air in homes, schools, offices, and healthcare facilities is now accessible, as it can be seamlessly integrated into current HVAC systems. Applied Photonix unveiled ViroZap® in Tampa, Fla., on September 15, 2026, marking its official entrance into the market. This innovation offers hospital-grade air purification outside of medical settings, presenting a vital solution for enhancing indoor air quality.

data.title: Banyan Wealth's Nicholas Sergio Ranked #54 Nationwide on AdvisorHub's 2026 Advisors to Watch Under $1 Billion List
data.description: In Red Bank, New Jersey, on September 15, 2026, Banyan Wealth celebrates recognition as a testament to the trust clients invest in them and the dedicated commitment to their financial success. The company takes pride in announcing their recent achievements, highlighting their unwavering dedication to providing top-notch services to their clients.

data.title: AI Investment Is Outpacing Organizations' Ability to Realize Value, New HTEC Research Finds
data.description: A global product engineering and AI transformation company, HTEC, unveiled a sneak peek of its AI Value Realization Report 2026, generated from a survey involving 1,500 C-level executives in the US, UK, Germany, and the UAE. The report suggests that AI investment is outpacing companies' capacity to leverage it efficiently, causing a significant disparity between AI expenditure and the tangible value organizations can harness from it.

data.title: FIRY Inc. Names Avenue Capital Chairman and CEO Marc Lasry to Board of Directors
data.description: Firy Inc., previously known as Skillz Inc. and listed on NYSE as FIRY, has appointed Marc Lasry as an independent director on its Board of Directors starting from Oct. 1, 2026. Andrew Paradise, the CEO and Founder of FIRY, stated that Lasry initially supported Skillz back in 2015 and has been actively engaged with the company's progress since then. Paradise highlighted Lasry's expertise in recognizing and nurturing value as an investor.
